newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso dips to 1,102 vs dlr in even trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso dips to 1,102 vs dlr in even trading.

text.p: Colombia's peso dipped 35 centavos to 1,102 against the dollar in even trading Monday, interbank traders said.
"There was little supply or demand for much of the day although there was a bit of speculation by large banks at the last moment," one Bogota trader said.
"The peso rate only dropped at the last moment when $25 million in export earnings was pumped into the market," he added.
Traders believe the peso will strengthen in much of the rest of the month. The peso opened at 1,102, hit an intraday high of 1,100.8 and sank to a low of 1,103.75.
Traders reported 370 deals worth a total $169 million.
